title: Refund denied less than 24 hours after purchase for a service that doesn't work
discussion_signal: A YouTube Music community post says a refund was requested within a day because the service did not work as expected, but the request was denied. The author asks whether the case can receive human review; the thread was locked with no replies.
linked_research_question: Whether a formal refund policy provides a usable remedy when a digital service fails, or whether the customer is left with an automated denial and no appeal path.
engagement: The page showed zero visible matching-question votes and no replies; this is an access and outcome signal, not a prevalence estimate.
limits: Community page is not a representative YouTube-user sample
The thread was locked and the service failure was not independently verified
